description: This file contains extension methods for configuring and adding Azure Table Grain Directory support to an Orleans silo builder, facilitating dependency injection and configuration setup.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectorySiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring Azure Table Grain Directory in Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: UseAzureTableGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Table Grain Directory as the default directory, with options to customize configuration.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainDirectory
methods.description: Adds an Azure Table Grain Directory to the silo builder with specified name and configuration options.
